messages:
alex: Hey team — I've addressed the changes from earlier review, squashed the commits into one, and updated the changelog. PTAL when you get a chance. I added a short smoke script in tools/smoke.sh.

morgan: thanks alex! quick q: did you change the KV allocator behavior? I saw a test tweak.

alex: @morgan just the allocator test was tightened; runtime behavior unchanged. the change is limited to the test harness and a nil-check in allocator.go. here's the diff snippet:
```
- if alloc == nil { return }
+ if alloc == nil { // defensive
+    return
+ }
```

sam: i'll take a look first thing tomorrow morning, but if it's small can do it tonight. any blockers for canary?

alex: no blockers. CI passed locally; pushing to CI now. canary should be fine once merged; infra already has capacity. 

ci-bot: CI started — unit tests 123/123, integration 8/8. (docker build + e2e queued)

riley: left one tiny nit inline (naming), otherwise lgtm. can you fix and I'll re-approve? :thumbsup:

alex: fixed the naming nit, force-pushed. changed `allocHandle` -> `allocatorHandle`. thanks @riley

ci-bot: CI rerun triggered by push — running tests.

infra-bot: Canary runway available in us-west-2 at 02:00 UTC, automatic canary scheduling enabled. 

sam: I pulled the branch and will run the smoke script in ~30m. if green I'll approve and merge. tagging @morgan for awareness.

morgan: sounds good — i'll be around for the merge window. if anything flakey pops up ping me. :+1:

alex: thanks everyone, appreciate the quick turnaround. if merge happens before EOD canary-start will be within the hour. will notify channel when merged.
